body.name: Observed-data minimax separation radius
body.construction: \(\rho_\star(n)=\inf\{\rho>0:\exists\text{ measurable }\phi_n:O^n\to[0,1],\ \sup_{P\in\mathcal P^{\mathrm{obs}}:\,V(P)=0}\mathbb E_{P^{\otimes n}}\phi_n(O^n)\le a_0,\ \sup_{P\in\mathcal P^{\mathrm{obs}}:\,V(P)\ge\rho^2}\mathbb E_{P^{\otimes n}}[1-\phi_n(O^n)]\le b_0\}\), with an empty alternative supremum equal to zero.
